body:
0:00 225 mg methylone taken orally.
0:30 Take a shower and feel slightly different. Effeminately 'coming up' on this drug.
:35 The effects much, much more extreme and different than a 150 mg dose I had taken a week before. Fingers and toes feel warm/cold. Also experiencing a slight head rush. Some desire to move, though standing up produces slight nausea. I'm glad I hadn't taken the 2c-d I was considering with this dose.
1:00 - 100mg gelcap booster dose prepared and taken. Music sounds absolutely amazing, better than I've ever experienced. I feel emotional connections to music. 'herb' I have smells amazing. Heightened sense.
2:00 Smoked 1/2 bowl dank marijuana.Smoking changed the high slightly. Less love/warmth but not a lot. Increase in body temperature.
Side note: While I've never had extascy, the effects of methylone are very close to what I'd imagine esctasy to be like (based on a lot of reading/research).
2:40 I feel like I'd be happy and entertained doing almost anything. The feeling is more geared towards relaxation and music as opposed to being very physically active. I just want to sit or lay, listen to music, and enjoy life. (though I do enjoy typing this report as well)
2:45 - some jaw-clenching. Not the worst, but annoying. I'm guessing the the booster dose is hitting due to the sudden appears of these previously-unseen side-effects.
3:20 - I feel very creative. Words come very naturally - my writing skills are apparently excellent, words paint idea pictures as my thoughts flow onto paper. My writings drifted towards philosophy and oddly enough, unifying humanity towards a common goal.
3:45 Smoking earlier has seemed to dull the effects, but only slightly. Plan to smoke on the comedown to help graduate the effects. Laying down the effects were less noticeable; sitting up or standing the effects are much more obvious. The room seems vibrant, despite it's normalcy. The room has a warm feel, or 'glowing.' The ceiling fan, chill online radio tunes, bed, time of day all seem, well, perfect.
4:00 Can still feel effects, though they have decreased, but no more than %15-%20 of the full effects. Music and words continue to have great power.
Another side note: At lower doses I think methylone can be used as an emotional therapy tool (exploring oneself, couple's therapy, bonding with one's you love, working through an emotional issue). It was just a sense of content/calmness at 150mg. At 225mg (then the booster) I was alone, but I felt extreme happiness/joy with some euphoria at it's peak. I'm writing a page(s) on expanding the human condition with/to love.
4:15 smoked again after finished current thought/point on papers.
5:15 - I am still writing my paper on life. Effects are slightly weaker, but still apparent, noticeable, and enjoyable.
5:45 - I still feel good. I'm surprised the effects are still as strong as they are, which I credit to the dosage. I didn't view my dose as huge, just average to above average. I'm still writing about the idea of life and ascension of consciousness to a higher level. Noticeable body temperature increase.a
6:00 High is still noticeable, but now approximately 50% intensity from peak, so I'm coming down.  Seems to be gradually fading out instead of dramatically stopping, which is contrary to some reports I read (perhaps because I'd smoked). Which is fine by me. I have class in 3 hours - I expect the effects will be gone with perhaps a very slight afterglow. I hope I don't get to tired and crash. Still feel hot and have some mild jaw clenching.
7:30 All effects are worn off. No hangover. Overall a very worthwhile substance.
7:20 lingering effects, dissipating, maybe 20-25% strength.
